versions.changelog:
Initial release of the skills-audit tool.

- Audits all installed WorkBuddy skills to identify duplicates, platform mismatches, and maintenance candidates.
- Scans SKILL.md files, compares against an approved (golden) list, and generates a structured report.
- Classifies skills as approved, unknown, or platform-specific for clean-up decisions.
- Provides a Python script (`audit_skills.py`) and a canonical golden list for flexible workflow integration.
- Offers clear recommendations and commands for removal of redundant skills after user confirmation.
